opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits participation in a Bitcoin investment program, making growth of the viewer’s Bitcoin its stated objective: “The objective of MeroTrading international is to grow your bitcoin.” It describes daily profits being added to the trading balance, including the stated example of $1,000 becoming $1,010, while linking eligibility for further benefits to recruitment and upfront participation. Members must build both sides of a team, and “20% of the daily profits are shared between all qualified members” according to the smaller leg. Qualification also requires introducing investors on both sides. Financial-risk and optional-affiliate disclaimers provide countercontext, but they do not change the direct invitation to invest or the condition that benefits depend on recruitment.

citations.quote: The objective of MeroTrading international is to grow your bitcoin.
This means your daily profit is added to your trading pool, and it becomes your new balance in trade.
20% of the daily profits are shared between all qualified members in accordance the size of their smallest team leg.
To qualify for the weekly Binary Profit-Sharing sharing bonuses you will need to have introduced at least two investors to the mti business one in your left leg and one in your right leg
